facility_draw_mw.citation: PowerBasis.facility_draw central (#87): 500 MW IT x PUE 1.265 (band mean of 1.1 efficient .. 1.43 cooling-dominated) — total facility draw

annual_consumption_gwh.citation: 632.5 MW x 8760 h x 0.9 load factor

avg_household_kwh_yr.citation: US avg residential use ~10,500 kWh/household/yr (EIA FAQ); assumption

transmission_coefficient.citation: stylized demand-to-price transmission (%price per %demand) under tight short-run supply — the low/high band is a SCREENING sensitivity, not an estimated elasticity or forecast

method: facility draw (PUE-adjusted, #87) -> annual GWh -> share of EIA state retail sales + households-equivalent; price pressure = demand share x transmission coefficient (STYLIZED screening sensitivity, not a forecast)
caveats: The demand share and households-equivalent are the robust, EIA-cited headline; the price-pressure band is a STYLIZED screening sensitivity, not a forecast of retail bills.
The campus buys at wholesale/industrial rates, not the residential price shown — residential price is the consumer-impact reference, not the campus bill.
Facility draw is itself an assumption-laden estimate (air-permit IT load x PUE band, #87); the load factor and transmission coefficient are assumptions.
